Ava: heads-up: `mkdocs build` is failing linkcheck on the new migration guide. A handful of anchors 404 in the published site.
Leo: any pattern in the broken fragments?
Ava: yes most of them are target anchors generated from headings that contain a non-breaking space (U+00A0) introduced by a copy/paste from Google Docs. Locally the heading looks normal but slugify produces weird percent-encoding in the generated anchor.
Rina: can you show an example?
Ava: snippet from the offending file:
```
## Migration to RedwoodA0Dedicated

Steps to migrate...
```
Leo: ah. the mkdocs slugify step doesn't normalize NBSP to regular space, so the anchor ends up as `migration-to-redwood%C2%A0dedicated` while links in other files use `migration-to-redwood-dedicated`. linkcheck sees them as different.
docs-bot: linkcheck: 7 broken fragment(s) in site build (job 5710). Report: artifacts/linkcheck-report.json
Rina: quick fixes: we can run a cheap preflight that normalizes whitespace in markdown headings (NBSP -> regular space) and run that as a filter in the docs CI. I'll draft a tiny Python script to rewrite headings in-place or emit a patch suggestion.
Ava: also probably worth adding a test in our linkcheck harness to normalize anchors before comparing, but that might mask author errors. Better to clean source.
Leo: agree. I'll add a small pre-commit hook config in the docs repo too, so authors catch NBSPs. For the short term, can we add redirects for the percent-encoded anchors on the live site?
Rina: infra said they can add 302 redirects for those three public pages if we send the list. Ava, can you extract the list and paste into the ticket?
Ava: done (ticket #DOCS-212). I also opened PR #4980 with the whitespace normalizer and tests. The CI job will fail until we reformat the offending files; I'm pushing a follow-up commit to fix them.
Leo: thanks. After we land the normalizer and fix the files we should re-run the mkdocs build. I'll monitor linkcheck.
Ava: re-run passed locally after replacements. Will queue CI.
Rina: nice. action items: add NBSP->space normalizer (PR #4980), add pre-commit check, create redirects for percent-encoded anchors (infra), re-run linkcheck.
Ava: thanks all. Small weird characters are the worst. :sweat_smile:
